newsitem.title: USA: U.S nuclear power plants set spring refuel outages.
newsitem.headline: U.S nuclear power plants set spring refuel outages.

text.p: Nearly a quarter of U.S. nuclear power generation will be shut in the first half of March as operators take advantage of a spring lull in power demand to maintain and refuel their electricity plants.

About 22 percent of U.S. nuclear generation capability will be in shutdown mode for scheduled refueling and maintenance on or in the two weeks previous to March 15, according to a Reuter nuclear plant outage report.
